t.rel: Under a compact of free association, the United States handles its defense. The damage from US nuclear tests in the 1940s and 1950s still lingers, and it continues to recognize Taiwan.
t.korea: As a major flag of convenience with a large ship registry, it registers many ships of Korean shipping companies.
t.know: The United States tested nuclear weapons at Bikini Atoll from 1946, and the bikini swimsuit takes its name from there.
t.etext: Its ship registry is among the largest in the world, and tuna fishing rights and US grants support the budget.
